title: Power and Energy in Electric Circuits
body: An electric heater has a resistance of 20 ohm and is connected to a 220 V supply. Calculate: (a) the current drawn by the heater, and (b) the energy consumed if the heater is used for 2 hours. Express your answer in kilowatt-hours (kWh).
source: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Electric Circuits
